sentences.text: None is present on behalf of the petitioner to press the petition nor there is any request for pass over or adjournment of the case.

2. This petition has been filed with the following main prayer:-
"Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the opposite party nos.1 and 2 to transfer the investigation of Case Crime No.440 of 2024, under Sections 376(2)(n), 506 IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Motipur, District Bahraich to any other independent agency."
3. Learned AGA, on the basis of counter affidavit, which has been filed today and taken on record,
submits that the Charge Sheet dated 06.01.2025 under Sections 376(2)(n), 506 IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act, has been filed in the matter in the court of Civil Judge Junior Division/ F.T.C. on 19.03.2025,
therefore, this petition has lost it's efficacy.

(Zafeer Ahmad,J.) (Rajnish Kumar,J.) November 7, 2025 Akanksha Sri/-
